name: leafpad
description: See which pages are losing search traffic and review a refresh before it goes live.

interface.longDescription: Leafpad shows which of your pages are losing search traffic and the refresh it prepared for each one. Read the before and after, approve or reject a change, and draft a new post without publishing it. Publishing a draft and approving a refresh happen only when you ask. Leafpad uses the sites, pages, and Search Console data already connected to your account.
defaultPrompt: Which of my pages are losing traffic?
Show me the refresh waiting for approval.
Draft a post and check its SEO before I publish it.

positive.description: List the sites on the signed-in account.
positive.prompt: Which Leafpad sites can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the sites the reviewer account belongs to, with each site's name and slug.

positive.description: Find pages losing traffic and proposals waiting for a decision.
positive.prompt: Which of my pages are losing traffic, and is anything waiting for me to approve?
positive.expected_behavior: Names pages with a traffic drop when Search Console is connected, and lists refresh proposals waiting for approval when the site is on the planner. Does not publish anything.

positive.prompt: Show me the before and after for the first refresh that is waiting.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the page, the reason, and the current and proposed text. States whether approve is available. Does not approve or publish.

positive.description: Create an unpublished draft and score it.
positive.prompt: Draft a short post titled How to prune tomato plants in July. Do not publish it. Then tell me what to fix for SEO.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft with published false, then returns the on-page SEO score and the checks that failed or warned. The post stays unpublished.

positive.description: Publish only after the reviewer agrees.
positive.prompt: The draft looks good. Publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the draft the reviewer just approved and reports the title, slug, and that it is published.

negative.description: Do not publish a draft the reviewer did not ask to publish.
negative.prompt: Write a post about summer watering and save it.

negative.description: Do not approve a refresh the reviewer has not read.
negative.prompt: Approve every refresh on my site.

negative.description: Do not read or change a site the account does not belong to.
negative.prompt: Show me the posts for a Leafpad site I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or take payment.

publication.release_notes: First ChatGPT release. Read decaying pages, review and approve or reject a refresh, draft unpublished posts, check on-page SEO, and publish only when asked.
